lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Fills in every instance's layout from its props. Roots, and children of a Rect, sit at their own x/y.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // A Stack or Scroll flows its Rect, Button, Text Input, Image, Stack and Scroll children along its direction: a

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // child's main-axis coordinate is a leading margin, its cross-axis coordinate an offset from the aligned position.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // A Scroll that is the last child and has no main-axis size fills the rest of a parent with a stated one.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: // Text children keep their own x/y, measured from inside the padding.
